latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of linux-ai-server — turn Linux machines into a headless AI inference cluster.

- Run headless Linux AI servers using systemd with no GUI or Docker overhead.
- Supports distributed inference with routing and fleet management across Ubuntu, Debian, RHEL, Fedora, and more.
- Native support for NVIDIA CUDA GPUs (experimental ROCm & CPU support).
- REST and OpenAI API compatibility; works with common AI models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, Mistral).
- Includes admin tools, firewall setup, monitoring endpoints, and setup guides.
- Guardrails require explicit user confirmation for all model downloads and deletions.
